dimensions.label: Operating posture
dimensions.definition: How an admitted method claim frames the way a structure tends to engage or orient before any reality conclusion.

dimensions.label: Decision
dimensions.definition: Decision-process or choice-orientation context; never a prescribed outcome.

dimensions.label: Perception
dimensions.definition: How attention, interpretation or perception is structurally framed by an admitted claim.

dimensions.label: Expression
dimensions.definition: Expression, communication or outward articulation represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Energy
dimensions.definition: Available capacity, activation or structural energy context without medical or factual inference.

dimensions.label: Rhythm
dimensions.definition: Cadence, recurrence or sequence represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Pressure
dimensions.definition: Constraint, load, friction or pressure represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Relationship
dimensions.definition: Relational or exchange context represented by admitted claims without compatibility scoring.

dimensions.label: Resources
dimensions.definition: Resource, wealth or support-structure context represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Work
dimensions.definition: Work, role or vocational-domain context represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Environment
dimensions.definition: Environmental, place or surrounding-context emphasis represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Change
dimensions.definition: Transition, activation or change context represented by admitted claims.

dimensions.label: Recovery
dimensions.definition: Restoration, resilience or recovery context represented by admitted claims; not a health diagnosis.

dimensions.label: Timing
dimensions.definition: Explicit timing or cycle context only when upstream authority makes it available.

dimensions.label: Identity
dimensions.definition: Identity-position or self-structure emphasis represented by admitted claims; not a fixed identity fact.

dimensions.label: Direction
dimensions.definition: Direction, orientation or trajectory context represented by admitted claims; not a guaranteed future outcome.
